Saint John Community Development Corporation works alongside Anacostia residents to expand education, health, and opportunity — sustaining and enhancing quality of life for children, youth, and adults across Ward 8.

Our Mission

“Local service making a world of difference — providing access to services and facilities that sustain and enhance our community's quality of life.”

Dedicated Service through Empowering Our Community

What we do

Four areas of dedicated service

01
Education & Literacy

Tutoring, reading and math help, and computer-skills training for children and adults.

Learn more →
02
Health & Wellness

Workshops on nutrition, diabetes, heart disease, and mental health, plus community screenings.

Learn more →
03
Community Support

Community meals, food distribution, holiday gift cards, and family assistance year-round.

Learn more →
04
Youth Development

Mentorship, summer programs, garden and hands-on learning, and career-outlook opportunities.

Learn more →

Stronger together

Rooted in partnership.

Nothing we do happens alone. SJCDC works hand-in-hand with St. John CME Church, Horton's Kids, the Capital Area Food Bank, Unity Health Care, the DC Public Library, and many more to bring real resources to Anacostia families.

From free community lunches to health screenings and holiday drives, our collaborations turn shared humanity into practical, everyday help.

See our impact

Our neighborhood

Anacostia — the heart of Ward 8.

From the historic MLK Jr. Avenue commercial strip to the Big Chair landmark, Anacostia is a community of deep culture and resilience. SJCDC is committed to serving the residents who make it home.
